jobs.title: Senior Bioinformatics Scientist – AI/ML for Protein Engineering
jobs.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

We are seeking a Senior Bioinformatics Scientist specializing in AI-enabled protein design and engineering to help invent the next generation of enzyme reagents that power Illumina sequencing platforms. Working at the intersection of machine learning, structural biology, and protein engineering, you will apply state-of-the-art computational approaches to design enzymes that expand the performance and capabilities of Illumina technologies. The role is based in San Diego. This is an exciting opportunity to be a part of Illumina’s continued growth.

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop and apply tailored bioinformatics tools and pipelines to design, engineer, and/or discover novel enzymes.
* Apply modern AI approaches, including protein language models, generative design methods, and structure-based machine learning, to predict and optimize enzyme function.
* Evaluate application, development, and implementation of novel computational methods and AI technologies to leverage protein sequence, structure, and/or experimental data for enzyme engineering.
* Create reusable templates, scripts, dashboards, or lightweight applications that allow project teams to run routine analyses and review computational recommendations more efficiently.
* Contribute to standards for data capture, model evaluation, design rationale, and reproducible computational workflows.
* Analyze high-throughput screening and sequencing datasets to guide protein optimization.
Participate in multi-disciplinarily protein engineering projects and interact with engineers, chemists, biophysicists, and protein scientists, to deliver protein variants with desired properties.  

All listed tasks and responsibilities are deemed as essential functions to this position; however, business conditions may require reasonable accommodations for additional task and responsibilities.

**Requirements:**

* Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 3 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD without experience; or equivalent work experience.
* Practical experience developing and applying AI/ML methods to protein and enzyme engineering
* Solid programming skills in at least one of the major programming languages (e.g., C/C++, Python, R).
* In-depth knowledge of protein sequence or structure modelling, protein-ligand interaction predictions and/or molecular simulations.
* Strong fundamentals in statistical modelling, algorithm design, data analysis, and/or visualization methods.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Collaborative, open and self-aware, team player, and able to rapidly integrate into cross functional teams.
Highly motivated individual with proven ability in thinking innovatively and the proven track record of productive research and development.  

  

**Preferred Experience:**

* Experience with foundational AI/ML models and protein language models for protein engineering, including generative protein design, zero-shot variant scoring, supervised learning, model-guided library design, denoising and uncertainty-aware learning, and multi-parameter optimization of protein properties..
* Experience with structure prediction, protein-ligand or enzyme-substrate modeling, molecular dynamics, docking, or biophysical analysis (e.g. Rosetta, Protein MPNN, RFdiffusion, Boltz, Alphafold)
* Experience developing data standards, assay schemas, dashboards, or lightweight tools for experimental scientists.
* Experience with AI agents.
* Deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX
* Large-scale biological data analysis using cloud or high-performance computing environments. Experience with high-performance computing, job schedulers, and/or GPU computing.
* Experience with experiments within protein engineering, e.g. directed-evolution, high-throughput screening.
* Knowledge of best software development practices and code version control, e.g. Git.
* Knowledge of UNIX environment and shell scripting.
* Broad knowledge of bioinformatics, genomics, and/or proteomics database, tools, and/or algorithms.
* Knowledge of biochemistry, enzymology, and/or molecular biology.
* Familiarity with next generation sequencing technologies, tools, and/or workflows.

jobs.title: Manager 3, Data Science - Data Foundations
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

Join the Intuit Customer Success Data Science & Analytics team as the Manager 3 leading Data Foundations. This team builds the governed, compliant data foundation that Intuit's Customer Success analytics and AI capabilities are built on. Metric definitions, clean domain entities, customer journey data products, semantic knowledge layer and the agentic tooling that keeps them healthy. You will lead a team of senior and staff-level data scientists accountable for building the Governed Data Foundation for ICS. This is a hands-on-adjacent people-leadership role. You will set technical direction, own the roadmap and its financial case, grow domain owners, and influence at the Director and VP level. The work spans two halves that must hold together: building data capabilities (consuming models, automating pipeline development and root-cause analysis, generating insights) and building the knowledge layer (understanding the data deeply enough that governed definitions and semantics can be trusted by downstream agents).This role is for someone who thrives in ambiguity, sets standards that outlast individual projects, and builds both systems and people that scale across teams and business units.

**Responsibilities**

### **Team Leadership & Talent**

* Lead, coach, and grow a team of senior, staff, and principal data scientists; develop domain leads capable of owning a data domain end to end, from source instrumentation through consumption.
* Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, calibration, and promotion advocacy for the team; build and maintain a strong talent pipeline and participate actively in A4A and talent assessment forums.
* Support craft progression across the team and raise the technical bar through review standards, documented best practices, and internal forums.
* Scale yourself through delegation and clear ownership boundaries; role-model an inclusive, high-trust environment that encourages constructive debate.

### **Strategy & Business Outcomes**

* Own the strategic vision, roadmap, success criteria, and financial case for the Data Foundations portfolio, partner with Finance and TPM to quantify and defend impact.
* Develop KPI frameworks that set direction across the organization, applying a "define once, calculate uniformly" metric standardization model across core data domains.
* Apply first-principles thinking to translate Customer Success business strategy into analytical and data-architecture problems at the Business Unit level.
* Combine insights, business acumen, and industry benchmarks to influence cross-functional leaders, represent the team's work in executive forums and organization-wide reviews.

### **Data Foundations & Governance**

* Drive a shift-left approach to data quality by embedding data design into the product development lifecycle so defects are prevented at source rather than cleaned downstream.
* Establish governed clean entities, standardized metric layers, and semantic/knowledge layers as the trusted source of truth for Customer Success data domains.
* Own end-to-end customer journey data products, stitching behavioral clickstream, contact touchpoints, and time-series journeys to pinpoint drop-offs and high-contact moments that drive cost-to-serve.
* Lead compliance and security execution for the organization's data estate by field-level access control, data-access management, and PII minimization against enterprise mandates and hard regulatory deadlines.
* Negotiate and maintain clear ownership boundaries with Data Engineering and PD partners on governed base tables, paved-path platforms, and the graduation of analyst-built assets into managed ownership.

### **AI Capabilities & Automation**

* Lead custom implementations of AI/GenAI capabilities for key business initiatives, in partnership with AI and platform teams.
* Direct the build-out of agentic data tooling for improving productivity and automation like pipeline migration and development agents, automated data-quality detection, and automated root-cause analysis targeting material reductions in downstream failures, detection time, and analyst hours spent on data bug management.
* Guide the team on measurement of AI-native experiences, connecting model performance metrics (cost, latency, accuracy, hallucination) to customer and business outcomes.
* Be a thought partner on build/buy decisions for analytics workflow tooling, and identify where new methodologies should be adopted and standardized across the organization.

**Qualifications**

### **Required**

  

* BS or MS in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics/Econometrics, Operations Research, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
* 14+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or data platform work, including 5+ years directly managing data scientists or analytics engineers.
* Demonstrated success leading teams that deliver governed data foundations at enterprise scale metric standardization, domain/entity modeling, data quality programs, or data product ownership.
* Strong hands-on technical foundation in SQL and Python sufficient to set architectural direction, review your team's work critically, and remain credible in deep technical discussions. This role requires a leader who has coded and can still read code, not one who has moved fully into administration.
* Experience with modern cloud data platforms and pipeline orchestration, and with migrating legacy analytics estates onto governed, paved-path platforms.
* Proven track record building AI/GenAI or agentic capabilities that automate data operations like validation, quality monitoring, root-cause analysis, or insight generation.
* Demonstrated ability to define metrics that shape business strategy and to influence Director- and VP-level stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience owning a multi-million-dollar impact portfolio, including building the financial case and reporting against it in executive forums.

jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology (DEEPT) is seeking a highly skilled and self-driven **Lead Data Analyst - Product Performance & Engagement** to join the Product & Tech Analytics team. This role is ideal for a strategic thinker with a deep analytical background who can independently design, execute, and deliver impactful insights that optimize Disney Streaming products (D+, Hulu). **This role will be a generalist across all areas of Product, Content, Subscriber, Messaging and Churn spaces.**

You will be part of a multidisciplinary team of analysts and analytical engineers responsible for assessing and improving browse telemetry data quality and producing high-impact analysis of streaming product performance across Hulu and Disney+. Working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Data Engineering, and Analytics partners, you will help develop scalable solutions, ensure metric consistency, and uncover the “why” behind key product trends and anomalies.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* **Own User Behavior Analysis:** Independently analyze user navigation and pathing data to uncover actionable insights and drive improvements to the Hulu user experience.
* **Forensics & Root Cause Analysis:** Drive rapid-response investigations and anomaly detection efforts to diagnose data or product issues and guide timely remediation.
* **Drive Strategic Optimization:** Develop and present recommendations for optimizing experiences, balancing business goals with user satisfaction.
* **Collaborate Cross-Functionally:** Act as a key partner to Product, Tech, Data Engineering and Data Product, and other teams to align analytics initiatives with overarching business strategies.
* **Lead End-to-End Projects:** Take full ownership of analytics projects, from identifying business needs and formulating hypotheses to delivering polished insights and recommendations.
* **Build Data Visualizations:** Create dashboards and advanced reports using tools like Tableau and Looker to track performance, trends, and experimentation outcomes.

**WHAT TO BRING**

* Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 7+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related discipline.
* Strong conceptual understanding of statistical theory, including hypothesis testing, probability distributions, sampling error, and confounding variables; ability to ensure that data collection and analytical frameworks adhere to sound statistical principles.
* Advanced SQL skills, with the ability to manipulate, cohort, and transform large datasets effectively.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with experience delivering insights to stakeholders at all levels.
* A demonstrated ability to solve complex, ambiguous business problems with minimal guidance.
* Strong proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker) and the ability to communicate insights through compelling storytelling.
* Expertise with statistical tools (e.g., R, Python) and data warehousing concepts.
* Comfortable leveraging AI in analytics use cases
* Experience with one or more analytics areas in the streaming space, e.g. Product, Content, Subscriber, Messaging and Churn

**NICE-TO-HAVES**

* Advanced degree in Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Ability to identify and appropriately call out issues to leadership
* Strong motivation and ability to learn from questions and experiences

Additional Information

**OpusClip** **is the world's No.1 AI video agent, built for authenticity on social media.**

We envision a world where everyone can authentically share their story through video, with no expertise needed. Within just 18 months of our launch, over 10 million creators and businesses have used OpusClip to enhance their social presence.

We have raised $50 million in total funding and are fortunate to have some of the most supportive investors, including SoftBank Vision Fund, DCM Ventures, Millennium New Horizons, Fellows Fund, AI Grant, Jason Lemkin (SaaStr), Samsung Next, GTMfund, Alumni Ventures, and many more.

Check out our latest coverage by Business Insider featuring our product and funding milestones, and our recognition as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2024.

Headquartered in Mountain View, we are a team of 100 passionate and experienced AI enthusiasts and video experts, driven by our core values:

* Be a Champion Team
* Prioritize Ruthlessly
* Ship fast, Quality Follows
* Obsess over customers

Be a part of this exciting journey with us!

**About the Role**
------------------

OpusClip is looking for a staff-level, product-oriented Data Science leader to build an effective and increasingly AI-native data function.

You will set priorities for a small Data team, personally lead our hardest analytical problems, improve how we measure product and business performance, and build systems that help teams make better decisions with less manual analytical work.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You may lead through direct management or technical leadership; formal people management is not required. We care more about your ability to lead through judgment, technical depth, and example.

You will work closely with Product, Growth, Finance, Engineering, and AI across product analytics, experimentation, user intelligence, data quality, growth measurement, AI data flywheels, and agentic analytics.

This expands the existing role from owning trusted metrics and analyses into setting direction and creating leverage across the Data function.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Lead the Data function**

* Set priorities for a small Data team and focus limited capacity on the highest-impact problems.
* Personally lead ambiguous or high-stakes analytical projects.
* Raise standards for metrics, experimentation, analytical quality, and decision-making.
* Lead and develop Data Scientists, analysts, and Data Engineers through technical direction and example.
* Reduce repetitive and reactive work by turning recurring problems into reusable systems and processes.

### **Drive product and business decisions**

* Analyze activation, retention, segmentation, monetization, user behavior, and lifetime value.
* Translate ambiguous business questions into rigorous analysis and clear recommendations.
* Identify opportunities where Data can directly improve key company metrics.
* Build stronger user profiling and segmentation to inform product strategy, operations, and company goal setting.
* Improve experimentation and causal measurement across Product and Growth.

The existing JD already emphasizes turning product and customer data into business decisions; this role owns that mandate at a broader level.

### **Improve data quality and measurement**

* Establish trusted definitions and validation for critical product and business metrics.
* Identify systematic issues across tracking, pipelines, transformations, tables, and dashboards.
* Partner with Data Engineering and Engineering to prevent recurring data problems rather than repeatedly fixing symptoms.
* Build reusable datasets, metric definitions, monitoring, and analytical frameworks that improve self-service.

You do not need to be a data infrastructure expert, but you should be technically strong enough to diagnose how data moves through a system, identify systemic failure modes, and work effectively with engineers to fix them.

### **Build Growth intelligence**

* Help Growth understand acquisition quality, retention, LTV, and the true value of different channels and customer segments.
* Improve performance marketing measurement beyond surface-level attribution toward experimentation and incrementality.
* Identify opportunities to improve CAC, conversion, retention, monetization, or other major business metrics.
* Build horizontal analytical tools and frameworks that enable Growth and Product teams to run better experiments and make faster decisions.

### **Partner with our AI teams**

* Support data curation, evaluation design, experimentation, and measurement for AI-powered product experiences.
* Identify product behavior that can become useful evaluation data, feedback signals, or failure cases.
* Connect AI quality with real user behavior and business outcomes.
* Strengthen the loop from **product usage data AI improvement better product**.

Model training experience is not required. The existing role already includes AI evaluation, curation, and online/offline measurement; this senior role is expected to make that collaboration systematic.

### **Build AI-native analytics**

* Use AI to automate recurring analytical work and improve the productivity of the Data team.
* Build trusted self-service tools for Product and business teams.
* Explore agentic systems that can detect unusual metric movements, identify contributing segments, generate hypotheses, and investigate likely causes.
* Help move the company from dashboards and one-off analysis toward proactive business intelligence.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Significant experience in data science, product analytics, decision science, or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated Staff, Principal, Lead, or equivalent scope, regardless of formal title.
* Strong product and business judgment. You identify important questions instead of waiting for them to be assigned.
* Strong SQL and Python skills and a willingness to remain hands-on.

The Lundquist Institute for Biomedical Innovation at Harbor-UCLA Medical Center (TLI) is Los Angeles County's preeminent independent, not-for-profit biomedical research hub, excelling in transforming scientific breakthroughs into practical therapies. **Job Summary**
---------------

The Chemical Lab Technician I performs routine laboratory sampling, analysis, process-control support, and equipment checks for chemical milling, chemical cleaning, wastewater treatment, and related aerospace manufacturing processes. Working under general supervision and within established methods, the technician prepares samples and standards, performs wet-chemistry and instrumental tests, calculates and completes authorized chemical additions, maintains accurate records, and promptly reports out-of-limit results or equipment failures. The role supports safe operations, product quality, environmental compliance, production schedules, customer requirements and GKN quality standards.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Collects samples from process tanks, rinse systems, and wastewater treatment points according to approved sampling and safety requirements.
* Performs routine wastewater, wet-chemistry, volumetric, and process-control tests; compares results with established limits and reports abnormal conditions.
* Prepares samples, standards, blanks, and dilutions for AAS and ICP analysis; operates equipment using approved methods and records results.
* Tests chemical milling, Chem Brite, alkaline cleaning, and other process solutions for concentration, dissolved metals, and specified bath conditions.
* Calculates routine chemical additions using approved formulas or worksheets and verifies the tank, bath volume, chemical identity, and amount before making an authorized addition.
* Performs assigned tank changes, solution transfers, cleaning, fresh solution make-up, and routine maintenance according to approved procedures.
* Prepares, labels, stores, and controls reagents and analytical standards according to established concentration, expiration, storage, and identification requirements.
* Perform required equipment checks and maintenance; documents completion and reports equipment failures.
* Recognizes out-of-limit results, preserves original data, performs authorized preliminary checks, and promptly escalates potential out-of-specification results.
* Maintains complete analytical records, chemical inventory, and compliant laboratory and storage areas.
* Follows applicable safety, environmental, quality, customer, export-control, and government-contracting requirements and performs other related duties as assigned.
* Support Waste water treatment areas around the facility.

**Job Qualifications**
----------------------

* Associate degree in chemistry, chemical technology, environmental science, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of relevant education, laboratory training, and experience.
* Related laboratory, chemical-processing, wastewater, or hazardous-material experience.

**Cancer Genomics • Organoid Biology • Tumor Microenvironment**

**About the Lin Laboratory**
============================

The Lin Laboratory at USC studies the molecular mechanisms that drive cancer development, progression, immune evasion, and therapeutic response, with a particular focus on head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) and other upper aerodigestive cancers. Our research integrates cancer genomics and epigenomics with functional biology, patient-derived organoid models, single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, and tumor immunology.

A major strength of the laboratory is the development and application of human organoid models. We use patient-derived tumor organoids and genetically defined organoid systems to reconstruct early malignant transformation, investigate genotype-to-phenotype relationships, model tumor-microenvironment interactions, and identify therapeutic vulnerabilities. These models are integrated with clinical specimens and multi-omic datasets to address biologically and clinically relevant questions.

The laboratory is embedded within the USC Head and Neck Center and the USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center, providing a highly collaborative environment with access to clinicians, patient specimens, advanced genomic technologies, and multidisciplinary expertise. Recent work from the laboratory has included studies of patient-derived HNSCC organoids, tumor immunity, epigenetic regulation, spatial tumor architecture, and mechanisms of metastasis and therapeutic response.

**Position**
============

We are seeking a motivated Research Associate to join the Lin Laboratory and contribute to NIH-funded studies of cancer biology. The successful candidate will participate in multidisciplinary projects spanning organoid biology, molecular and cellular biology, cancer genomics, tumor immunology, and functional studies of therapeutic response.

This position is particularly well suited for a scientist who wants to work at the interface of experimental and translational cancer research. Depending on experience and interests, projects may involve patient-derived organoid culture and characterization, molecular perturbation, drug-response studies, tumor-immune co-culture, flow cytometry, histology and imaging, and integration of experimental data with single-cell or spatial genomic analyses.

**Research Environment**
========================

The Lin Laboratory is part of a highly collaborative research community on the USC Health Sciences Campus. The laboratory works closely with investigators in the USC Head and Neck Center, USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center, and collaborating institutions. Team members have opportunities to develop expertise across experimental and computational approaches and to contribute to projects that connect fundamental mechanisms of cancer with patient-derived models and clinical questions.

**Qualifications**

Candidates should have a PhD, MD, or equivalent doctoral degree in cancer biology, molecular biology, cell biology, genetics/genomics, immunology, bioengineering, biomedical sciences, or a related field.

Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:

* Mammalian cell culture, primary cells, or organoid culture
* Molecular and cellular biology, including RNA/DNA analysis, western blotting, qPCR, immunofluorescence, or related methods
* Cancer biology, tumor immunology, or functional studies of therapeutic response
* Flow cytometry, microscopy, histology, or quantitative image analysis
* Genomics, transcriptomics, single-cell or spatial data analysis, or quantitative biology

Research Associate

**Cancer Genomics • Organoid Biology • Tumor Microenvironment**

  
  

**About the Lin Laboratory**
============================

The Lin Laboratory at USC studies the molecular mechanisms that drive cancer development, progression, immune evasion, and therapeutic response, with a particular focus on head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) and other upper aerodigestive cancers. Our research integrates cancer genomics and epigenomics with functional biology, patient-derived organoid models, single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, and tumor immunology.

  
  

A major strength of the laboratory is the development and application of human organoid models. We use patient-derived tumor organoids and genetically defined organoid systems to reconstruct early malignant transformation, investigate genotype-to-phenotype relationships, model tumor-microenvironment interactions, and identify therapeutic vulnerabilities. These models are integrated with clinical specimens and multi-omic datasets to address biologically and clinically relevant questions.

  
  

The laboratory is embedded within the USC Head and Neck Center and the USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center, providing a highly collaborative environment with access to clinicians, patient specimens, advanced genomic technologies, and multidisciplinary expertise. Recent work from the laboratory has included studies of patient-derived HNSCC organoids, tumor immunity, epigenetic regulation, spatial tumor architecture, and mechanisms of metastasis and therapeutic response.

  
  

**Position**
============

We are seeking a motivated Research Associate to join the Lin Laboratory and contribute to NIH-funded studies of cancer biology. The successful candidate will participate in multidisciplinary projects spanning organoid biology, molecular and cellular biology, cancer genomics, tumor immunology, and functional studies of therapeutic response.

This position is particularly well suited for a scientist who wants to work at the interface of experimental and translational cancer research. Depending on experience and interests, projects may involve patient-derived organoid culture and characterization, molecular perturbation, drug-response studies, tumor-immune co-culture, flow cytometry, histology and imaging, and integration of experimental data with single-cell or spatial genomic analyses.

  
  

**Research Environment**
========================

The Lin Laboratory is part of a highly collaborative research community on the USC Health Sciences Campus. The laboratory works closely with investigators in the USC Head and Neck Center, USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center, and collaborating institutions. Team members have opportunities to develop expertise across experimental and computational approaches and to contribute to projects that connect fundamental mechanisms of cancer with patient-derived models and clinical questions.

  
  

**Qualifications**
==================

Candidates should have a PhD, MD, or equivalent doctoral degree in cancer biology, molecular biology, cell biology, genetics/genomics, immunology, bioengineering, biomedical sciences, or a related field.

  
  

Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:

* Mammalian cell culture, primary cells, or organoid culture
* Molecular and cellular biology, including RNA/DNA analysis, western blotting, qPCR, immunofluorescence, or related methods
* Cancer biology, tumor immunology, or functional studies of therapeutic response
* Flow cytometry, microscopy, histology, or quantitative image analysis
* Genomics, transcriptomics, single-cell or spatial data analysis, or quantitative biology

Strong candidates will be intellectually curious, careful in experimental design and data interpretation, able to work independently while collaborating effectively with others, and interested in developing new experimental and analytical skills.

* Operates and maintains sophisticated laboratory and scientific equipment.
* Performs other related duties as assigned or requested. The University reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.
  

  

**Why Join the Lin Lab?**
=========================

This position offers the opportunity to work with human patient-derived models and clinically anchored datasets while gaining broad experience in modern cancer biology. Research Associate projects are designed to allow meaningful scientific ownership and contribution to publications and ongoing NIH-funded research programs.

============

Please apply through the USC Careers system and include a curriculum vitae and a brief description of your research experience and interests. Candidates are encouraged to review the Lin Laboratory website before applying: https://sites.usc.edu/linlab/

We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community.  
  
**Job Summary**  
  
We are seeking a Post Baccalaureate Research Assistant to work on instrument and data calibration for the DSA test array at the Owens Valley Radio Observatory. The position involves hands-on work with a world-class instrument and its data; characterizing and fine-tuning receiver settings, solving for baseline and antenna-position errors, and measuring and improving the pointing accuracy of the telescopes. The position is well suited to someone early in their research career, for example, a recent graduate considering a PhD, or a student seeking research experience. You will receive mentorship from project scientists and engineers, contribute directly to the observatory's scientific output, and have opportunities to co-author technical notes and publications.  
  
**Essential Job Duties**  

* Calibrate DSA observational data: derive and apply gain, bandpass, and delay solutions; solve for and correct errors in baselines and antenna positions.
* Improve instrument performance: characterize receiver behavior and fine-tune receiver settings to optimize sensitivity and stability.
* Improve telescope pointing: plan and conduct pointing measurements, analyze the results, and derive updated pointing models.
* Develop and maintain calibration software: write and extend Python analysis tools and pipeline components; keep code under version control and documented.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in physics, astronomy, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related field (completed or expected by the start date).
* Proficiency in Python for scientific data analysis (e.g., NumPy/SciPy, working with large datasets).
* Some hands-on research experience - through coursework projects, a senior thesis, an internship (e.g., REU), or prior employment.
* Clear oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to work on-site at OVRO in Big Pine, CA, including occasional outdoor work at the antennas.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Coursework or experience in radio astronomy, interferometry, or signal processing.
* Familiarity with radio-astronomy software such as CASA, or with calibration concepts.
* Experience working in a Linux environment and with version control (git).
* Experience with laboratory instrumentation, RF/electronics test equipment, or antenna measurements.
Experience with radio-frequency interference (RFI) identification and mitigation.  

  
  
**Required Documents**  

* Resume.
* Cover letter.

jobs.description:
**Location:** San Diego, CA
  
**Experience:** 3+ Years
  
**Employment Type:** Contract

### **Position Overview:**

We are looking for a skilled **Automation QA Engineer – Genomics / Bioinformatics** to ensure the quality, reliability, and accuracy of software applications supporting genomics, sequencing, and life sciences workflows.

The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience in **Python-based test automation**, software quality engineering, and genomics or laboratory environments. This role involves validating application functionality, genomic data outputs, system integrations, and end-to-end workflows in collaboration with software engineering, QA, scientific, and laboratory teams.

This position focuses on **software testing and quality assurance**, rather than developing bioinformatics pipelines. The successful candidate will help ensure that applications and data outputs meet scientific requirements and reflect real-world laboratory processes.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop, maintain, and execute automated test suites using Python and applicable testing frameworks.
* Create and execute test plans, test cases, regression suites, and data-validation scenarios.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing of genomics and life sciences applications.
* Validate sequencing workflows, genomic data outputs, variant-calling results, and sample-to-result traceability.
* Collaborate with wet lab and dry lab teams to understand laboratory processes, sample lifecycles, instrument outputs, and data transfers.
* Translate scientific and laboratory requirements into practical test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
* Test integrations with **Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS)**, including sample tracking, chain of custody, and result reporting.
* Identify, document, track, and verify software defects, partnering with engineering teams on root-cause analysis and resolution.
* Verify data integrity, audit trails, traceability, and the accuracy of application outputs.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and improve test coverage, reliability, and execution efficiency.
* Maintain test data, enhance automation frameworks, and contribute to continuous QA process improvements.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, defect triage, and release testing.

### **Required Skills and Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Bioinformatics, Bioengineering, Life Sciences, or a related field.
* At least 3 years of experience in QA, software testing, quality engineering, or test automation.
* Strong hands-on Python programming skills for automated test development.
* Experience with testing frameworks such as **pytest, unittest, or Robot Framework**.
* Working knowledge of genomics and bioinformatics concepts, including sequencing, genomic data workflows, sample-to-data lifecycle, common genomic file formats, and variant-calling outputs.
* Experience testing software within a **biotechnology, genomics, bioinformatics, life sciences, or laboratory environment**.
* Familiarity with wet lab and/or dry lab workflows and the ability to validate software behavior against laboratory requirements.
* Experience testing or integrating with LIMS platforms.
* Strong understanding of functional, integration, regression, and data-validation testing methodologies.
* Ability to analyze application outputs, troubleshoot issues, and manage defects through resolution.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills when working with engineers, QA professionals, scientists, and laboratory personnel.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Previous experience as an Automation QA Engineer or Quality Engineer in a genomics or bioinformatics organization.
* Familiarity with cloud-based genomics platforms, life sciences data platforms, or laboratory information systems.
* Experience with API testing and tools such as Postman, Selenium, or comparable automation technologies.
* Experience incorporating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Knowledge of life sciences and healthcare compliance frameworks, including HIPAA, CLIA, CAP, or 21 CFR Part 11.
* Understanding of regulated software environments, data integrity, audit trails, and end-to-end traceability.
* Experience validating laboratory instrument data or downstream genomic analysis results.

### **Technical Skills:**

**Required**

* Python-based test automation
* pytest, unittest, or Robot Framework
* Functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing
* Data validation and test case development
* Genomics / Bioinformatics fundamentals
* LIMS integration and laboratory workflows
* Defect tracking and root-cause analysis
* CI/CD testing practices

**Preferred**

* API testing and automation
* Postman and Selenium
* Cloud-based genomics platforms and data lakes
* Healthcare and life sciences compliance
* Laboratory information systems and instrument-generated data

**Overview**
------------

Join the Intuit Customer Success Data Science & Analytics team as the Manager 3 leading Data Foundations. This team builds the governed, compliant data foundation that Intuit's Customer Success analytics and AI capabilities are built on. Metric definitions, clean domain entities, customer journey data products, semantic knowledge layer and the agentic tooling that keeps them healthy. You will lead a team of senior and staff-level data scientists accountable for building the Governed Data Foundation for ICS. This is a hands-on-adjacent people-leadership role. You will set technical direction, own the roadmap and its financial case, grow domain owners, and influence at the Director and VP level. The work spans two halves that must hold together: building data capabilities (consuming models, automating pipeline development and root-cause analysis, generating insights) and building the knowledge layer (understanding the data deeply enough that governed definitions and semantics can be trusted by downstream agents).This role is for someone who thrives in ambiguity, sets standards that outlast individual projects, and builds both systems and people that scale across teams and business units.

**Responsibilities**

### **Team Leadership & Talent**

* Lead, coach, and grow a team of senior, staff, and principal data scientists; develop domain leads capable of owning a data domain end to end, from source instrumentation through consumption.
* Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, calibration, and promotion advocacy for the team; build and maintain a strong talent pipeline and participate actively in A4A and talent assessment forums.
* Support craft progression across the team and raise the technical bar through review standards, documented best practices, and internal forums.
* Scale yourself through delegation and clear ownership boundaries; role-model an inclusive, high-trust environment that encourages constructive debate.

### **Strategy & Business Outcomes**

* Own the strategic vision, roadmap, success criteria, and financial case for the Data Foundations portfolio, partner with Finance and TPM to quantify and defend impact.
* Develop KPI frameworks that set direction across the organization, applying a "define once, calculate uniformly" metric standardization model across core data domains.
* Apply first-principles thinking to translate Customer Success business strategy into analytical and data-architecture problems at the Business Unit level.
* Combine insights, business acumen, and industry benchmarks to influence cross-functional leaders, represent the team's work in executive forums and organization-wide reviews.

### **Data Foundations & Governance**

* Drive a shift-left approach to data quality by embedding data design into the product development lifecycle so defects are prevented at source rather than cleaned downstream.
* Establish governed clean entities, standardized metric layers, and semantic/knowledge layers as the trusted source of truth for Customer Success data domains.
* Own end-to-end customer journey data products, stitching behavioral clickstream, contact touchpoints, and time-series journeys to pinpoint drop-offs and high-contact moments that drive cost-to-serve.
* Lead compliance and security execution for the organization's data estate by field-level access control, data-access management, and PII minimization against enterprise mandates and hard regulatory deadlines.
* Negotiate and maintain clear ownership boundaries with Data Engineering and PD partners on governed base tables, paved-path platforms, and the graduation of analyst-built assets into managed ownership.

### **AI Capabilities & Automation**

* Lead custom implementations of AI/GenAI capabilities for key business initiatives, in partnership with AI and platform teams.
* Direct the build-out of agentic data tooling for improving productivity and automation like pipeline migration and development agents, automated data-quality detection, and automated root-cause analysis targeting material reductions in downstream failures, detection time, and analyst hours spent on data bug management.
* Guide the team on measurement of AI-native experiences, connecting model performance metrics (cost, latency, accuracy, hallucination) to customer and business outcomes.
* Be a thought partner on build/buy decisions for analytics workflow tooling, and identify where new methodologies should be adopted and standardized across the organization.

**Qualifications**

### **Required**

  

* BS or MS in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics/Econometrics, Operations Research, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
* 14+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or data platform work, including 5+ years directly managing data scientists or analytics engineers.
* Demonstrated success leading teams that deliver governed data foundations at enterprise scale metric standardization, domain/entity modeling, data quality programs, or data product ownership.
* Strong hands-on technical foundation in SQL and Python sufficient to set architectural direction, review your team's work critically, and remain credible in deep technical discussions. This role requires a leader who has coded and can still read code, not one who has moved fully into administration.
* Experience with modern cloud data platforms and pipeline orchestration, and with migrating legacy analytics estates onto governed, paved-path platforms.
* Proven track record building AI/GenAI or agentic capabilities that automate data operations like validation, quality monitoring, root-cause analysis, or insight generation.
* Demonstrated ability to define metrics that shape business strategy and to influence Director- and VP-level stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience owning a multi-million-dollar impact portfolio, including building the financial case and reporting against it in executive forums.

* Lead and mentor junior Electronics and Electrical Technicians.

Research Associate

**Cancer Genomics • Organoid Biology • Tumor Microenvironment**

**About the Lin Laboratory**
============================

The Lin Laboratory at USC studies the molecular mechanisms that drive cancer development, progression, immune evasion, and therapeutic response, with a particular focus on head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) and other upper aerodigestive cancers. Our research integrates cancer genomics and epigenomics with functional biology, patient-derived organoid models, single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, and tumor immunology.

A major strength of the laboratory is the development and application of human organoid models. We use patient-derived tumor organoids and genetically defined organoid systems to reconstruct early malignant transformation, investigate genotype-to-phenotype relationships, model tumor-microenvironment interactions, and identify therapeutic vulnerabilities. These models are integrated with clinical specimens and multi-omic datasets to address biologically and clinically relevant questions.

The laboratory is embedded within the USC Head and Neck Center and the USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center, providing a highly collaborative environment with access to clinicians, patient specimens, advanced genomic technologies, and multidisciplinary expertise. Recent work from the laboratory has included studies of patient-derived HNSCC organoids, tumor immunity, epigenetic regulation, spatial tumor architecture, and mechanisms of metastasis and therapeutic response.

**Position**
============

We are seeking a motivated Research Associate to join the Lin Laboratory and contribute to NIH-funded studies of cancer biology. The successful candidate will participate in multidisciplinary projects spanning organoid biology, molecular and cellular biology, cancer genomics, tumor immunology, and functional studies of therapeutic response.

This position is particularly well suited for a scientist who wants to work at the interface of experimental and translational cancer research. Depending on experience and interests, projects may involve patient-derived organoid culture and characterization, molecular perturbation, drug-response studies, tumor-immune co-culture, flow cytometry, histology and imaging, and integration of experimental data with single-cell or spatial genomic analyses.

**Research Environment**
========================

The Lin Laboratory is part of a highly collaborative research community on the USC Health Sciences Campus. The laboratory works closely with investigators in the USC Head and Neck Center, USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center, and collaborating institutions. Team members have opportunities to develop expertise across experimental and computational approaches and to contribute to projects that connect fundamental mechanisms of cancer with patient-derived models and clinical questions.

**Qualifications**
==================

Candidates should have a PhD, MD, or equivalent doctoral degree in cancer biology, molecular biology, cell biology, genetics/genomics, immunology, bioengineering, biomedical sciences, or a related field.

Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:

* Mammalian cell culture, primary cells, or organoid culture
* Molecular and cellular biology, including RNA/DNA analysis, western blotting, qPCR, immunofluorescence, or related methods
* Cancer biology, tumor immunology, or functional studies of therapeutic response
* Flow cytometry, microscopy, histology, or quantitative image analysis
* Genomics, transcriptomics, single-cell or spatial data analysis, or quantitative biology

Strong candidates will be intellectually curious, careful in experimental design and data interpretation, able to work independently while collaborating effectively with others, and interested in developing new experimental and analytical skills.

* Analyzes and evaluates research data and provides interpretations requiring significant knowledge of a specialized area of research.
* Searches the literature, utilizing available resources regarding new methodologies, and designs experiments accordingly.
* Contributes to the development of research documentation for publication and/or prepares technical reports, papers, and records.
* Operates and maintains sophisticated laboratory and scientific equipment.
* Performs other related duties as assigned or requested. The University reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.

This position offers the opportunity to work with human patient-derived models and clinically anchored datasets while gaining broad experience in modern cancer biology. Research Associate projects are designed to allow meaningful scientific ownership and contribution to publications and ongoing NIH-funded research programs.

This position is particularly well suited for a scientist who wants to work at the interface of experimental and translational cancer research. Depending on experience and interests, projects may involve patient-derived organoid culture and characterization, molecular perturbation, drug-response studies, tumor-immune co-culture, flow cytometry, histology and imaging, and integration of experimental data with single-cell or spatial genomic analyses.

  
  

**Research Environment**
========================

The Lin Laboratory is part of a highly collaborative research community on the USC Health Sciences Campus. The laboratory works closely with investigators in the USC Head and Neck Center, USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center, and collaborating institutions. Team members have opportunities to develop expertise across experimental and computational approaches and to contribute to projects that connect fundamental mechanisms of cancer with patient-derived models and clinical questions.

  
  

**Qualifications**
==================

Candidates should have a PhD, MD, or equivalent doctoral degree in cancer biology, molecular biology, cell biology, genetics/genomics, immunology, bioengineering, biomedical sciences, or a related field.

  
  

Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:

* Mammalian cell culture, primary cells, or organoid culture
* Molecular and cellular biology, including RNA/DNA analysis, western blotting, qPCR, immunofluorescence, or related methods
* Cancer biology, tumor immunology, or functional studies of therapeutic response
* Flow cytometry, microscopy, histology, or quantitative image analysis
* Genomics, transcriptomics, single-cell or spatial data analysis, or quantitative biology

Strong candidates will be intellectually curious, careful in experimental design and data interpretation, able to work independently while collaborating effectively with others, and interested in developing new experimental and analytical skills.

  
  

**Job Accountabilities**
========================

* Searches the literature, utilizing available resources regarding new methodologies, and designs experiments accordingly.
* Contributes to the development of research documentation for publication and/or prepares technical reports, papers, and records.
* Operates and maintains sophisticated laboratory and scientific equipment.
* Performs other related duties as assigned or requested. The University reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.
  

  

**Why Join the Lin Lab?**
=========================

This position offers the opportunity to work with human patient-derived models and clinically anchored datasets while gaining broad experience in modern cancer biology. Research Associate projects are designed to allow meaningful scientific ownership and contribution to publications and ongoing NIH-funded research programs.

  
  

**To Apply**

### **Position Overview:**

We are looking for a skilled **Automation QA Engineer – Genomics / Bioinformatics** to ensure the quality, reliability, and accuracy of software applications supporting genomics, sequencing, and life sciences workflows.

The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience in **Python-based test automation**, software quality engineering, and genomics or laboratory environments. This role involves validating application functionality, genomic data outputs, system integrations, and end-to-end workflows in collaboration with software engineering, QA, scientific, and laboratory teams.

This position focuses on **software testing and quality assurance**, rather than developing bioinformatics pipelines. The successful candidate will help ensure that applications and data outputs meet scientific requirements and reflect real-world laboratory processes.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop, maintain, and execute automated test suites using Python and applicable testing frameworks.
* Create and execute test plans, test cases, regression suites, and data-validation scenarios.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing of genomics and life sciences applications.
* Validate sequencing workflows, genomic data outputs, variant-calling results, and sample-to-result traceability.
* Collaborate with wet lab and dry lab teams to understand laboratory processes, sample lifecycles, instrument outputs, and data transfers.
* Translate scientific and laboratory requirements into practical test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
* Test integrations with **Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS)**, including sample tracking, chain of custody, and result reporting.
* Identify, document, track, and verify software defects, partnering with engineering teams on root-cause analysis and resolution.
* Verify data integrity, audit trails, traceability, and the accuracy of application outputs.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and improve test coverage, reliability, and execution efficiency.
* Maintain test data, enhance automation frameworks, and contribute to continuous QA process improvements.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, defect triage, and release testing.

### **Required Skills and Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Bioinformatics, Bioengineering, Life Sciences, or a related field.
* At least 3 years of experience in QA, software testing, quality engineering, or test automation.
* Strong hands-on Python programming skills for automated test development.
* Experience with testing frameworks such as **pytest, unittest, or Robot Framework**.
* Working knowledge of genomics and bioinformatics concepts, including sequencing, genomic data workflows, sample-to-data lifecycle, common genomic file formats, and variant-calling outputs.
* Experience testing software within a **biotechnology, genomics, bioinformatics, life sciences, or laboratory environment**.
* Familiarity with wet lab and/or dry lab workflows and the ability to validate software behavior against laboratory requirements.
* Experience testing or integrating with LIMS platforms.
* Strong understanding of functional, integration, regression, and data-validation testing methodologies.
* Ability to analyze application outputs, troubleshoot issues, and manage defects through resolution.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills when working with engineers, QA professionals, scientists, and laboratory personnel.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Previous experience as an Automation QA Engineer or Quality Engineer in a genomics or bioinformatics organization.
* Familiarity with cloud-based genomics platforms, life sciences data platforms, or laboratory information systems.
* Experience with API testing and tools such as Postman, Selenium, or comparable automation technologies.
* Experience incorporating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Knowledge of life sciences and healthcare compliance frameworks, including HIPAA, CLIA, CAP, or 21 CFR Part 11.

* Python-based test automation
* pytest, unittest, or Robot Framework
* Functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing
* Data validation and test case development
* Genomics / Bioinformatics fundamentals
* LIMS integration and laboratory workflows
* Defect tracking and root-cause analysis

**Preferred**

* API testing and automation
* Postman and Selenium
* Cloud-based genomics platforms and data lakes
* Healthcare and life sciences compliance
* Laboratory information systems and instrument-generated data
